scope: Sequential single-run desktop Chromium English long-article translation through Magpie / OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
limitations: One run per size/language; no latency distribution or SLA.
Paragraph prefixes from one fixed Wikipedia snapshot; tables, lists and paragraphs outside the eligibility filter are excluded.
Application cache disabled, upstream prompt caching and provider load uncontrolled.
Timer includes automatic scrolling to the first unfinished paragraph, model calls, scheduling and DOM rendering; page loading excluded.
A failed cell stops at the first observed extension error; its elapsed time is not successful full-page latency.
Structural preservation and script-presence checks do not guarantee sentence-level semantic completeness. Latin-language identity needs review.

results.method: Real public page in a clean Chromium extension profile. Select approximately the requested word count in complete article paragraphs, restrict translation to them, automatically scroll to untranslated paragraphs. Timer starts immediately before page.start. Model output is nonstreaming. Includes bridge, model, scheduling and DOM rendering; excludes browser/page load. Application cache disabled; upstream prompt caching is uncontrolled.
results.requestTimingNote: Browser network events may not expose offscreen worker requests; DOM timings are authoritative

sample.wordCountMethod: Whitespace-separated tokens in selected complete paragraphs
